semanticChanges: ADR-0030 adds module-owned resources with Host deadlines and cleanup authority; ADR-0031 adds declared run inputs, per-run scopes and instance templates.
ADR-0032 replaces handwritten capability compatibility with contract descriptors and authoring builders; ADR-0035 completes only unambiguous required bindings.
ADR-0036 replaces bound handles with module entries and static groups; ADR-0037 independently pins providers, roots and every non-completed row.
FMS v1.1 adds optional sub-features and composition contracts; each consumer retains its own adopted FMS version.
ADR-0034 adds optional observation state with one writer, subscriber-owned signal-bound subscriptions, command ports, testing-only helpers and leak checks.
Current carrier limits, input validation and execution outcomes changed; these are real Assembly contract changes, not only optional dynamic Host guidance.

The SDK growth slice is existing development tooling using the Foundation SDK verifier and does not call Assembly authoring or runtime APIs. Its frozen P0 observation remains historical; no composition source migration is required in this slice.
Qualification and activation remain pending/hold until independent authority, exact source binding and released observation custody exist. Current guidance review cannot provide those proofs.
